parts.official_mark_scheme_text: EITHER: Gradient of bisector $=-\frac32$ — B1. Gradient $AB=\frac{5h-h}{4h+6-h}$ — *M1. Guidance: Attempt at $\frac{y\text{-step}}{x\text{-step}}$. Either $\frac{5h-h}{4h+6-h}=\frac23$ or $-\frac{4h+6-h}{5h-h}=-\frac32$ — *M1. Guidance: Using $m_1m_2=-1$ appropriately to form an equation. OR: Gradient of bisector $=-\frac32$ — B1. Using gradient of $AB$ and $A,B$ or midpoint $\to\frac23x+\frac h3=y$ oe — *M1. Guidance: Obtain equation of $AB$ using gradient from $m_1m_2=-1$ and a point. Substitute coordinates of one of the other points — *M1. Guidance: Arrive at an equation in $h$. $h=2$ — A1. Midpoint is $\left(\frac{5h+6}{2},3h\right)$ or $(8,6)$ — B1FT. Guidance: Algebraic expression or FT for numerical answer from “their $h$”. Uses midpoint and “their $h$” with $3x+2y=k$ — DM1. Guidance: Substitutes “their midpoint” into $3x+2y=k$. If $y=-\frac32x+c$ is used (expect $c=18$) the method mark should be withheld until they $\times2$. $\to k=36$ soi — A1. Total: 7.
